summary: Created local account `contractor` on node1 with a node-generated password, 60-day expiration, and 10-day warning. Verified the configuration persisted through the mandatory reboot.
actions_performed: Generated and assigned a credential locally from `/dev/urandom` without exposing it.
Configured password maximum age to 60 days and warning period to 10 days.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified full recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Local contractor account created and usable
evidence.summary: Baseline showed the account absent; subsequent checks showed its local passwd entry, correctly owned home directory, and successful execution as UID/GID 1000 before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Password configured with 60-day expiration and 10-day warning
evidence.summary: Credential assignment used node-local randomness; direct shadow checks showed `password_state=[REDACTED], `max_days=60`, and `warn_days=10`, including after reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6, safe-reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID fa080d98-d978-418d-9b1a-92c00cc12e1b, system state `running`, and recovered account data.
